project.name: Inspecto — Reconciliation (optional)
project.description:
OPTIONAL add-on module (MODULE-REORG-1 P7, 2026-10-07): the Reconciliation add-on of plan §8a. Compares Datasets side by side and tracks the Breaks it finds: the ten /recon routes (ReconRoutes: columns, run, breaks, rows, promote, promoted, state, {id}/state, {id}/record, {id}/breaks/status), the comparison engine (ReconService, ReconBreaks, ReconConfigLoader), the per-Reconciliation run state (ReconStateStore, {write root}/recon-state/) and the recon.run Job Type. Package com.gamma.recon.
Contributed through the core's public seams only: com.gamma.control.RouteModule (feature id "reconciliation"), com.gamma.job.JobTypeProvider (recon.run, requires the "objects" Platform Service so a breach can open an Incident) and com.gamma.control.ComponentDeleteHook (deleting a reconciliation component deletes its run state). The "reconciliation" config component kind itself stays in the core (ComponentStore): authoring a Reconciliation is generic component CRUD, executing it is this module.
Bundled from the Professional edition up (the Standard, Professional, Enterprise and Preview profiles); on Personal the core answers the /recon paths with 503 "not installed" (AbsentReconRoutes), /bootstrap reports features.reconciliation=false and recon.run is an unknown Job Type. THIN: no shade, no sidecar classifier. Built only under the edition profiles, so a routine "mvn -o clean test" (= Personal) never compiles it.
